yt_title: How to download your saved reels from Instagram
caption:
Instagram will email you every save. Free. Here's how to download your saved reels.

1. Instagram → Settings → Accounts Center
2. Your information and permissions → Download your information
3. Some of your information → tick only Saved
4. Download to device, format HTML, date range All time

Instagram emails you when the file is ready. Drop the zip into SaveSort: every save sorted by topic, in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Save this, so the steps are here on export day.

Sorty's voice is AI. The saves and numbers are real.

#savedreels #instagramtips #howto #productivity #organization
